relations.description: T3396 running restricts sending of ESM DATA TRANSPORT message unless specific conditions are met.
Condition allows ESM DATA TRANSPORT transmission when T3396 is running.
Condition allows ESM DATA TRANSPORT for exception data reporting when T3396 is running.
ESM DATA TRANSPORT can be sent when T3396 expires or is stopped.
Abort and re-initiate behavior leads to sending TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST with 'signalling active' flag.
Immediate re-initiate behavior leads to including ESM DATA TRANSPORT in CONTROL PLANE SERVICE REQUEST.
CONTROL PLANE SERVICE REQUEST message includes ESM DATA TRANSPORT message.
ESM DATA TRANSPORT message requires NAS MAC calculation for integrity protection.
